decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ( Photo, Design and Access Statement, Drawing Number RC/02A, RC/16, RC/02A (Proposed Ground Floor Plan with landscaping)
RC/03A (Proposed Ground Floor Plan with Detail Cross-sections)
RC/04A (Proposed Detail Cross-sections)
RC/05A (Existing and Proposed First Floor Plans with Details)
RC/06A (Proposed Second Floor Plans with Details) RC/11A (Proposed Details), RC/12A (Proposed Details), RC/13A (Proposed Site Survey Plan), RC/14A (Existing Floor Plans), RC/15A (Proposed Floor Plans), RC/16A (Location Plan) received 22/01/13.
 
RC/01D (Proposed Site Layout Plan) received 09/07/13

RC/07B (Proposed Cross-Section)
RC/08B (Proposed Elevations)
RC/09B (Proposed Elevations)
RC/10B (Proposed Elevations)
Received 01/07/13
 ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - Before the commencement of the development hereby permitted details of the brick(s) to be used in the development hereby permitted, including samples if so required, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, and all the brick(s) used in the development shall conform to the details/samples so approved.

Condition : 4 - . No work permitted by this consent shall commence until a detailed specification of the proposed mortar mix and joint profiles have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The development shall be carried out using the approved specification.
Condition : 5 - Angle grinders or other mechanical cutting tools shall not be used for      cutting out of stonework, brickwork and / or chasing out for repointing.

Condition : 6 - Other than those shown on the submitted drawings under this listed building consent/planning permission, there shall be no external alterations to the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority and for which a schedule of dilapidations or other justification would be required.

Condition : 7 - Full details of any acoustic/thermal insulation and fire precautions works to demonstrate their effect on the character and appearance of the listed building shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority before the commencement of the development hereby permitted
and the development shall be carried out in complete accordance with the detail so approved.

NOTE: You are advised that acoustic/thermal insulation or fire precautions works which adversely affect the character of the listed building will not be permitted, in particular:

i) works should be designed to avoid damage to cornices, ceiling roses and panelled doors. The preferred option is for works to be carried out within ceiling voids;

ii) the installation of sealed double-glazed units will not be acceptable. Consideration should be given to draught exclusion measures.

iii) areas where existing elements or materials should be retained under covering materials shall be agreed in advance with the LPA and recorded.

Condition : 8 - Before the commencement of the development hereby permitted the final material and colour of the rainwater goods hereby permitted shall be approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, and the material and colour so approved shall be applied within one month of the development hereby permitted being
first brought into use and thereafter so maintained unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 9 - Notwithstanding the approved drawings, windows shall be repaired as a preference to replacement where practically possible. All new and repaired window frames, glazing bars and external door frames shall be of timber construction, white painted and thereafter so maintained.

Condition : 10 - . Notwithstanding the approved drawings, large scale details (at a scale of at least 1:20) of the following features shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and no work shall commence in advance of that approval. These details shall provide for a cross sectional detailed drawing at 1:20 scale for each feature and the development shall be constructed in accordance with the details so approved:

Notwithstanding the approved drawings note that repairs rather than replacement is the default position and should be itemised for approval; and together with new works which will become hidden, recorded (annotated photographs and sketches) during approved work: 
Structural Works to the staircase, noting that interventions should be minimized; balustrades; doors; the projecting watching-bay window, its structure and new supports; effects of repairs and loadings onto the existing structure; access to the hidden valley; (walls and roof).
New work: relationship of new lead rear roof with existing upper roof; roof extension dormer cheeks and junction detailing; dormer windows; position if any of solar panels and connections to them; wall finishes to bathroom enclosures; bar and fittings to the ground floor including alterations to floor and ceiling levels and finishes; casings and panelling.

Condition : 11 - . No work permitted by this consent shall commence until a schedule showing the retention or re-use of doors and / or doorcases, fire surrounds, decorative plaster work, panelling and other internal features has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The development shall be carried out using the approved schedule.

Condition : 12 - The permitted works shall not take place until a scheme detailing measures to protect the safety and stability of the existing building during the works hereby permitted, which has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority has been implemented. Protection from the weather in accordance with the scheme shall be provided at all times during the progress of work. Repair works once commenced must be completed appropriately.

Condition : 13 - No works shall take place on site until the applicant has secured the making of a detailed record / implementation of a scheme of recording of the building(s) concerned to a specification. This must be carried out by an archaeological / building recording consultant or organisation approved by the Local Planning Authority in accordance with a written scheme of investigation which shall first be submitted to and agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 14 - No cables, wires, aerials, pipework (except rainwater downpipes as shown on the approved plans), meter boxes or flues shall be fixed to any elevation.

Condition : 15 - No works shall take place until full details of the proposed works including 1:20 scale sample elevations and 1:1 scale joinery profiles have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The works shall be implemented in strict accordance with the agreed details and maintained as such thereafter: windows  doors, skirtings, architraves and mouldings.

Condition : 16 - This approval is limited to the works shown on the approved drawings and does not indicate approval for associated or enabling works that may be necessary to carry out the scheme. Any further works must be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to any works commencing.

Condition : 17 - The smoke detectors, fire alarm call points, fire alarms, emergency lighting fittings and control boxes shall be located in unobtrusive positions in the corners of rooms and their electrical cabling systems shall not be surface mounted but concealed within the floors, ceilings and walls, except where otherwise approved where this can be accommodated without disruption or damage through access or notching, and the walls, floors and ceilings made good to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 18 - No works shall take place until details of the method of fire protection of the walls, floors, ceilings and doors, including 1:5 scale sections through walls and ceilings, 1:20 scale elevations of doors and 1:1 scale moulding sections, have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. All existing original doors shall be retained and where they are required to be upgraded to meet fire regulations details of upgrading works shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Self-closing mechanisms, if required, shall be of the concealed mortice type. The works shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 19 - This consent does not permit the demolition or dismantling of any part of the building, or the removal of any internal/external feature, floor, wall or ceiling surface, except in so far as the alterations hereby approved necessitate the removal of certain parts of the existing structure as specifically shown on the approved drawings. Any opening up shown on the approved drawings shall include the least possible removal of adjacent material to achieve the structural intervention.

Condition : 20 - The northern two-thirds of the site lie within the Roman Road Archaeological Priority Area. Archaeological inspection and recording should take place during removal of the coach house foundations, recording the depth and width of material and retaining samples for inspection. During construction of the pub's rear extension foundations and the first new house; and for new drainage runs in the vicinity, a watching brief should look out for evidence of earlier fabric. If evidence of old fabric is found the local planning authority should be informed and an investigation and recording of what is found decided upon; if necessary by calling upon English Heritage for expert guidance.
description: Conversion into three houses with erection of a single storey rear extension and rear roof extension with associated parking and amenity space following the demolition of existing single storey extension and coach house (Listed building consent)
